question: Could you assess the relationship between the poverty rates from the previous year's census data and the percentage of births without maternal morbidity for the years 2016 to 2018? Use only data for births where no maternal morbidity was reported and for each year, use the 5-year census data from the year before to compute the Pearson correlation coefficient
sql:
WITH births AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as birth_year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS as county_fips,
    SUM(Births) as total_births,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as births_no_morbidity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY birth_year, county_fips
),
pct AS (
  SELECT 
    birth_year,
    county_fips,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(births_no_morbidity, total_births) * 100 as pct_no_morbidity
  FROM births
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
merged AS (
  SELECT p.birth_year, p.county_fips, c.poverty_rate, p.pct_no_morbidity
  FROM pct p
  LEFT JOIN census_2015 c ON p.county_fips = c.geo_id AND p.birth_year = 2016
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.birth_year, p.county_fips, c.poverty_rate, p.pct_no_morbidity
  FROM pct p
  LEFT JOIN census_2016 c ON p.county_fips = c.geo_id AND p.birth_year = 2017
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.birth_year, p.county_fips, c.poverty_rate, p.pct_no_morbidity
  FROM pct p
  LEFT JOIN census_2017 c ON p.county_fips = c.geo_id AND p.birth_year = 2018
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    birth_year,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) as sum_x,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_xy,
    SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) as sum_x2,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y2
  FROM merged
  WHERE poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY birth_year
)
SELECT 
  birth_year,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y))
  ) as pearson_r
FROM stats
ORDER BY birth_year
